title: Sources: Zelenskyy asked Trump to secure Elon Musk's permission for the use of Starlink to guide drone strikes inside Russia, but Trump was noncommittal (The Atlantic)
summary: The Atlantic: Sources: Zelenskyy asked Trump to secure Elon Musk's permission for the use of Starlink to guide drone strikes inside Russia, but Trump was noncommittal — Ukraine wants to start using Musk's Starlink to target ballistic-missile launchers inside Russia. — During closed-door talks …
